data.body:
Ticket 9100 worked as a LEAF (no children, so rebar-implement Phase 0 did not apply); executed with the same TDD/held-out discipline.

Worktree ../9100-generated-markers off origin/main. Plan-review BLOCKED first pass on a
correct finding (two existing tests assert on_disk == build_prompt_index(), which the
marker would break); remediated by enumerating both in Scope with a worked example, plus
the CONTRIBUTING AC and file_impact. Second pass PASS + signed.

RED first: tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py — 8 failing for the right reasons.
Held out the fixed-point + README-table tests, left only the two happy-path marker
assertions in the tree, dispatched a sonnet implementer (1 attempt). Restored the full
oracle: 16/16 green including the tests the implementer never saw.

Teeth: 3 mutations, each red in the right test (strip index marker -> fixed-point test;
drop the underscore guard -> load_catalog test; delete a README row -> table test).

Gerrit change 1420. All nine local gates pass; both JSON markers verified as fixed points
by double regeneration against the committed tree.
